blocks.prompt: 7. A poster must have \(200\text{ cm}^{2}\) printed area with margins of 2 cm on top/bottom and 3 cm on sides. Find poster dimensions to minimize paper used.
blocks.explanation:
A minimum problem: least paper means least total area of the poster.
Given: printed area 200 cm², margins 2 cm (top and bottom) and 3 cm (each side).
Plan: printed area \(x\) by \(y\); the poster is \((x + 6)\) by \((y + 4)\); use \(xy = 200\) to get one variable, then the derivative tests.
steps:
Given: printed area \(200\text{ cm}^{2}\); margins 2 cm at top and bottom, 3 cm at each side.
To find: the poster's width and height for the least paper.
Method: paper area as a function of the printed width \(x\); \(P'(x) = 0\) and the second derivative test.

Variables and constraint
Let the printed area be \(x\) cm wide and \(y\) cm high.
\[xy = 200 \Rightarrow y = \dfrac{200}{x}, \quad x > 0 \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Why: the printed area is fixed.

Paper area
Poster width \(= x + 3 + 3 = x + 6\); poster height \(= y + 2 + 2 = y + 4\).
\[P = (x + 6)\left(\dfrac{200}{x} + 4\right)\]
\[P = 224 + 4x + \dfrac{1200}{x} \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Why: expanding: \(200 + 4x + \frac{1200}{x} + 24\).

Critical point
\[\dfrac{dP}{dx} = 4 - \dfrac{1200}{x^{2}} \quad \text{...(3)}\]
\[x^{2} = 300 \Rightarrow x = 10\sqrt{3} \approx 17.32\]
Why: the negative root is rejected because a width is positive; \(\sqrt{300} = \sqrt{100 \times 3}\).

Second derivative test
\[\dfrac{d^{2}P}{dx^{2}} = \dfrac{2400}{x^{3}} > 0 \ \text{ for } x = 10\sqrt{3}\]
Why: positive, so \(P\) is minimum at \(x = 10\sqrt{3}\).

Dimensions
\[y = \dfrac{200}{10\sqrt{3}} = \dfrac{20\sqrt{3}}{3} \approx 11.55\]
\[\text{Width} = 6 + 10\sqrt{3} \approx 23.32\text{ cm}\]
\[\text{Height} = 4 + \dfrac{20\sqrt{3}}{3} \approx 15.55\text{ cm}\]
Why: from (1), then add the margins.

Least paper and check
\[P = 224 + 40\sqrt{3} + 40\sqrt{3}\]
\[P = 224 + 80\sqrt{3} \approx 362.56\text{ cm}^{2}\]
Check: \(23.3205 \times 15.5470 \approx 362.56\) ✓. Also the printed sides are in the ratio \(x : y = 3 : 2\), the same as side margin : top margin.
blocks.final_answer: Poster width \(6 + 10\sqrt{3} \approx 23.32\) cm and height \(4 + \frac{20\sqrt{3}}{3} \approx 15.55\) cm (printed area \(10\sqrt{3} \times \frac{20\sqrt{3}}{3}\) cm); least paper \(224 + 80\sqrt{3} \approx 362.56\text{ cm}^{2}\).
